title: Scalar GlobalTensor access is pathologically slow for matmul
lesson: The baseline BMM kernel running on Ascend 910B4 with scalar GlobalTensor access is ~500-1000x slower than PyTorch's torch.matmul. Each element access goes through global memory with hundreds of cycles latency. Even a simple UB tiling with DMA can recover 3-4x of this gap. Full Cube-unit utilization would be needed for competitive performance.
